entities.name: P37993 Potato aucuba mosaic virus coat protein
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt P37993 (100% identity and coverage).
Viral coat protein required for genome encapsidation; forms ribonucleoprotein complexes with TGB1 helicase and viral RNA.
Annotated localization: virion; GO terms include helical viral capsid and structural molecule activity.
Sequence-derived properties: 249 aa, 27.13 kDa, theoretical pI 8.44; no explicit catalytic reaction retrieved.
